title: Sakina Aalame Gurbat hai
body:
SAKINA AALAME GHURBAT HAI OUR
SHABBIR KA GHAM HAI
BAHUTH BECHAIN HAI BACCHI PIDAR KEY WASTEY BETA
ZARA TUM NABZ TO DEKHO…..
<<DIVIDER>>
KEY SANSEIN KYU YEH MADDHAM HAI
JIYE TO KIS TARAH BACCHI HAI KAANAOU SEY LAHU JAARI
GHAZAB KEY QAID KHANE MEIN…..
KAHAAN ZAQMAO KA MARHAM HEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
CHACHA NA SATH HEIN GHAZI KAHE TOU KISSE BECHARI
YAHAAN ZINDAAN MEIN BHAIYYA…..
HAWA KA CHALNA BHI KAM HEIN
PHATA SA USKA HAI KURTA LAHU HAI JIS MEIN BIBI KA
<<DIVIDER>>
BANA HAI KAFN YEH USKA…..
YEH GHAM BHI EK NAYA GHAM HA
